CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 40.5
   C. 10
   D. 9

2. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 90

3. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

4. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 3

6. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

8. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

9. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 9
   C. 1
   D. 20

10. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

11. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

14. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

15. Solve for x: x + 8 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 13

16. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

17. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
